clm-pku-undergraduate-exam-devices.text: PKU undergraduate examination rules restrict electronic devices and other nonessential items at examination seats unless the chief examiner provides otherwise. This is a general exam rule, not a university-wide AI-use mandate.

evidence.quote: 第二十七条  除非主考教师另有规定，学生只能携带必要的文具参加考试，其它所有物品（包括空白纸张、手机等电子设备）不得带入座位；已经带入考场的手机等电子设备必须关机，与其他物品一起集中放在监考人员指定位置，不得随身携带或带入座位及旁边。

clm-pku-undergraduate-independent-exams.text: PKU undergraduate examinees must independently complete examination answers within the prescribed time. Applicable exam instructions still determine permitted aids; this general rule does not establish a comprehensive AI-specific ban.

scope.en: Course, assignment, data and Wharton Academy conditions have distinct scopes. Tool access is not assessment permission.
scope.zh: 课程、作业、数据和 Wharton Academy 项目条件各有范围；工具获取不代表考核许可。

coursework.en: AI use depends on the instructor and assignment. Penn has no standardized student AI-use policy; without other guidance, treat AI as assistance from another person. Wharton Academy examples apply only to that program and require instructor permission.
coursework.zh: AI 使用由教师及作业要求决定，宾大没有统一的学生 AI 使用政策；无其他指导时按他人协助处理。Wharton Academy 许可示例只适用于该项目，并以教师允许为前提。
coursework.meaningEn: Course, assignment, data and Wharton Academy conditions have distinct scopes. Tool access is not assessment permission.
coursework.meaningZh: 课程、作业、数据和 Wharton Academy 项目条件各有范围；工具获取不代表考核许可。

exams.en: No uniform university-wide AI exam permission was established. Follow the specific assessment rules; Wharton Academy expressly prohibits AI cheating in its exams and tests. Tool availability grants no exam permission.
exams.zh: 未建立全校统一 AI 考试许可；须核对具体考核规则。Wharton Academy 明确禁止在其考试中用 AI 作弊；工具开放不构成考试许可。
exams.meaningEn: Course, assignment, data and Wharton Academy conditions have distinct scopes. Tool access is not assessment permission.
exams.meaningZh: 课程、作业、数据和 Wharton Academy 项目条件各有范围；工具获取不代表考核许可。

disclosure.en: Community guidance directs transparency and disclosure, while stating it is not a final policy. Instructors may impose specific citation/disclosure requirements; Wharton Academy treats uncredited AI work as plagiarism.
disclosure.zh: 社区指导要求透明说明 AI 使用，同时声明并非最终政策。教师可规定具体引用与披露要求；Wharton Academy 将未注明来源的 AI 内容视为抄袭。
disclosure.meaningEn: Course, assignment, data and Wharton Academy conditions have distinct scopes. Tool access is not assessment permission.
disclosure.meaningZh: 课程、作业、数据和 Wharton Academy 项目条件各有范围；工具获取不代表考核许可。

privacy_data.en: Protect student, patient and research data. Unlicensed tools must not receive identifiable student information; student work requires permission even if anonymized. Do not require personal information or IP in unlicensed tools. Licensed-tool data conditions differ.
privacy_data.zh: 保护学生、患者及研究数据。未许可工具不得接收可识别学生信息；上传学生作品即使匿名也须获许可。不得要求学生向未许可工具输入个人信息或知识产权；许可工具数据条件各异。
privacy_data.meaningEn: Course, assignment, data and Wharton Academy conditions have distinct scopes. Tool access is not assessment permission.
privacy_data.meaningZh: 课程、作业、数据和 Wharton Academy 项目条件各有范围；工具获取不代表考核许可。

approved_tools.en: Institutional tools have product-specific audience, account, cost and data conditions. PennChat requires PennKey and campus/VPN access; verify current entitlements with IT. Tool access is separate from assessment permission.
approved_tools.zh: 机构工具各有人员资格、账号、费用与数据条件。PennChat 须用 PennKey 并在校园网络或 VPN 访问；具体资格向 IT 核对。工具可获取与考核许可分别判断。
approved_tools.meaningEn: Course, assignment, data and Wharton Academy conditions have distinct scopes. Tool access is not assessment permission.
approved_tools.meaningZh: 课程、作业、数据和 Wharton Academy 项目条件各有范围；工具获取不代表考核许可。

research_publication.en: Consult department leadership and discipline publication standards about AI authorship. Research-participant data requires appropriate consent and prior IRB approval; data/IP safeguards and Penn Center for Innovation consultation apply.
research_publication.zh: 研究署名须咨询部门及学科发表标准；研究参与者数据须遵守知情同意并事先取得 IRB 批准，还须遵守数据与知识产权条件，涉及知识产权咨询 Penn Center for Innovation。
research_publication.meaningEn: Course, assignment, data and Wharton Academy conditions have distinct scopes. Tool access is not assessment permission.
research_publication.meaningZh: 课程、作业、数据和 Wharton Academy 项目条件各有范围；工具获取不代表考核许可。

academic_integrity.en: Course rules determine unauthorized AI assistance. Wharton Academy has its own restrictions. CETLI advises discussing suspected misuse with students and consulting CSA; it says not to upload work into AI detectors and rejects their accuracy as misconduct evidence. Formal hearing/appeal procedures remain a gap.
academic_integrity.zh: 未经许可的 AI 协助由课程规则判断，Wharton Academy 另有项目限制。CETLI 建议与学生沟通并可咨询 CSA，明确不要向 AI 检测器上传作品，检测结果不足以作为不端证据。正式听证与申诉程序仍待补证。
academic_integrity.meaningEn: Course, assignment, data and Wharton Academy conditions have distinct scopes. Tool access is not assessment permission.

teaching_guidance.en: Instructors set and communicate course/assignment expectations. Unlicensed tools must not require student personal information or IP; consider licensed tools for mandatory coursework. Investigate suspected misuse through conversation and appropriate consultation.

topicBasis.coursework: AI use depends on the instructor and assignment. Penn has no standardized student AI-use policy; without other guidance, treat AI as assistance from another person. Wharton Academy examples apply only to that program and require instructor permission.
topicBasis.exams: No uniform university-wide AI exam permission was established. Follow the specific assessment rules; Wharton Academy expressly prohibits AI cheating in its exams and tests. Tool availability grants no exam permission.
topicBasis.disclosure: Community guidance directs transparency and disclosure, while stating it is not a final policy. Instructors may impose specific citation/disclosure requirements; Wharton Academy treats uncredited AI work as plagiarism.
topicBasis.privacy_data: Protect student, patient and research data. Unlicensed tools must not receive identifiable student information; student work requires permission even if anonymized. Do not require personal information or IP in unlicensed tools. Licensed-tool data conditions differ.
topicBasis.approved_tools: Institutional tools have product-specific audience, account, cost and data conditions. PennChat requires PennKey and campus/VPN access; verify current entitlements with IT. Tool access is separate from assessment permission.
topicBasis.research_publication: Consult department leadership and discipline publication standards about AI authorship. Research-participant data requires appropriate consent and prior IRB approval; data/IP safeguards and Penn Center for Innovation consultation apply.
topicBasis.academic_integrity: Course rules determine unauthorized AI assistance. Wharton Academy has its own restrictions. CETLI advises discussing suspected misuse with students and consulting CSA; it says not to upload work into AI detectors and rejects their accuracy as misconduct evidence. Formal hearing/appeal procedures remain a gap.

topicBasis.security_procurement: Moderate/high-risk data involves Privacy Office review and Information Security consultation coordinated by Procurement; IP involves Penn Center for Innovation. University business AI processes should have oversight and output verification.

exams.en: The current Code prohibits unauthorized AI assistance in exams and restricts in-class assistance to what the exam or proctor provides. Understand the exact assessment conditions. Earlier courses and graduate/honor-code procedures have separate rules.
exams.zh: 现行守则禁止考试中未经授权的 AI 协助，课堂考试协助限考卷或监考提供的内容；须了解具体考核条件。旧课程、研究生及荣誉守则程序另行区分。
exams.meaningEn: Current Code transition, course authorization, graduate/honor-code procedures and Communication PhD rules have distinct scopes. Tool access is not assessment permission.
exams.meaningZh: 区分新旧守则、课程授权、研究生／荣誉守则程序和 Communication 博士规则；工具获取不代表考核许可。

disclosure.en: The undergraduate guide requires attribution when AI use is permitted, including quoting verbatim output and acknowledging paraphrases under instructor rules. Communication PhD A/B work separately requires disclosure of AI-assisted language/grammar changes and committee discussion.
disclosure.zh: 本科指南要求获准 AI 使用注明来源：逐字输出加引号、转述也须标明，并遵守教师格式。Communication 博士 A／B 环节另要求披露 AI 语言语法修改并与委员会讨论。
disclosure.meaningEn: Current Code transition, course authorization, graduate/honor-code procedures and Communication PhD rules have distinct scopes. Tool access is not assessment permission.
disclosure.meaningZh: 区分新旧守则、课程授权、研究生／荣誉守则程序和 Communication 博士规则；工具获取不代表考核许可。

privacy_data.en: Do not put confidential, proprietary, regulated or sensitive Cornell data into public AI. The committee report's training-data warning concerns third-party services; approved platforms have product-specific limits. Copilot Basic is Low Risk only; the limited AI Platform pilot lists Moderate Risk and below.
privacy_data.zh: 不得向公共 AI 输入康奈尔保密、专有、受监管或敏感数据。委员会训练数据警示针对第三方服务；受控平台按产品条件判断。Copilot Basic 仅低风险，AI Platform 限量试点列中风险及以下。
privacy_data.meaningEn: Current Code transition, course authorization, graduate/honor-code procedures and Communication PhD rules have distinct scopes. Tool access is not assessment permission.
privacy_data.meaningZh: 区分新旧守则、课程授权、研究生／荣誉守则程序和 Communication 博士规则；工具获取不代表考核许可。

approved_tools.en: Firefly needs an Adobe licence; Cornell AI Platform is a limited free pilot; Copilot Basic is free for eligible affiliates aged 18+ with Low Risk data. Zoom AI Companion security/privacy are still being evaluated in the Hub entry. Tool access is not assessment permission.
approved_tools.zh: Firefly 须有 Adobe 许可；Cornell AI Platform 是限量免费试点；Copilot Basic 面向年满 18 岁的合资格成员且仅限低风险数据。Hub 仍称 Zoom AI Companion 在安全隐私评估中。工具获取不等于考核许可。
approved_tools.meaningEn: Current Code transition, course authorization, graduate/honor-code procedures and Communication PhD rules have distinct scopes. Tool access is not assessment permission.
approved_tools.meaningZh: 区分新旧守则、课程授权、研究生／荣誉守则程序和 Communication 博士规则；工具获取不代表考核许可。

research_publication.en: The 2023 research task-force report is non-binding advice. Communication PhD A/B exam papers/dissertations have specific AI drafting restrictions and disclosure/committee requirements; these are not a Cornell-wide thesis ban. Check applicable research, IRB, sponsor and publication requirements separately.
research_publication.zh: 2023 年研究报告是非约束性建议。Communication 博士 A／B 考试及论文有专门 AI 起草限制、披露和委员会要求，不是全校论文禁令；另核对研究、IRB、资助方与发表规则。
research_publication.meaningEn: Current Code transition, course authorization, graduate/honor-code procedures and Communication PhD rules have distinct scopes. Tool access is not assessment permission.
research_publication.meaningZh: 区分新旧守则、课程授权、研究生／荣誉守则程序和 Communication 博士规则；工具获取不代表考核许可。

academic_integrity.en: The Code explicitly covers unauthorized AI and fabricated citations. Findings require clear and convincing evidence; notice, response and review stages apply. Accepting Responsibility is voluntary and waives ordinary appeals. CTI discourages unreliable detectors; no detector score or AI use alone establishes guilt or an automatic sanction. Announced in-person Ithaca/Tech implementation scope and internal Registry records, disclosure limits and no-violation expungement must also be checked.
academic_integrity.zh: 守则明确涵盖未授权 AI 和虚假引用；认定须有清楚且令人信服的证据，并有通知、答复与复核程序。自愿 Accepting Responsibility 会放弃通常申诉。CTI 不推荐不可靠检测器，AI 使用或分数本身不自动定罪处分。 自愿承担责任的 Ithaca／Cornell Tech 线下课程实施范围、内部记录及披露／清除条件须另行核对。
academic_integrity.meaningEn: Current Code transition, course authorization, graduate/honor-code procedures and Communication PhD rules have distinct scopes. Tool access is not assessment permission.
academic_integrity.meaningZh: 区分新旧守则、课程授权、研究生／荣誉守则程序和 Communication 博士规则；工具获取不代表考核许可。

teaching_guidance.en: Communicate course and assignment AI rules clearly. Instructors choose the permitted scope. The 2023 committee does not recommend AI summative grading; this is guidance, not a universal disciplinary prohibition.
teaching_guidance.zh: 清楚说明课程和作业 AI 规则，由教师确定许可范围。2023 年委员会不推荐 AI 总结性评分；这是指导，不是全校纪律禁令。
teaching_guidance.meaningEn: Current Code transition, course authorization, graduate/honor-code procedures and Communication PhD rules have distinct scopes. Tool access is not assessment permission.

disclosure.en: The reported compliance-and-integrity principle calls for disclosure under applicable rules. The follow-up interview identifies substantive AI contribution to an academic outcome as a trigger for clear, prominent marking or declaration in the form required by the university, unit or instructor.
disclosure.zh: 公开报道的合规诚信原则要求依规披露；后续采访说明，AI 对学术成果有实质性贡献时，应按学校、院系或任课教师要求清晰、显著标注或声明，不能假定所有任务使用同一格式。
disclosure.meaningEn: Public reports of AI guiding principles; ordinary degree students for discipline; research-related activity for investigation; distinct degree-review and SIGS unit rules.
disclosure.meaningZh: 区分指导原则公开报道、普通学历学生纪律、研究活动调查、学位复核与深圳院级规则。

privacy_data.en: The public guiding-principles account prohibits using sensitive, classified or unauthorized data to train or drive AI models. A campus tool listing does not authorize sensitive-data entry; current retention and tenant settings were not verified.
privacy_data.zh: 指导原则的公开报道禁止使用敏感信息、涉密或未授权数据训练或驱动模型。校内工具目录不构成敏感数据输入授权；现行留存和租户设置未核实。
privacy_data.meaningEn: Public reports of AI guiding principles; ordinary degree students for discipline; research-related activity for investigation; distinct degree-review and SIGS unit rules.
privacy_data.meaningZh: 区分指导原则公开报道、普通学历学生纪律、研究活动调查、学位复核与深圳院级规则。

approved_tools.en: Xiaoda is an institutional student assistant. A dated September 2026 report states it opened to all undergraduate and graduate students in June 2025; an undated center page retains older pilot wording. Account entitlements and price were not tested. Access is separate from assessment or sensitive-data permission.
approved_tools.zh: 清小搭为校内学伴。2026 年 9 月报道确认其于 2025 年 6 月面向全体本研学生开放；未标日期的中心页仍有旧试运行措辞。账号权限和费用未实测；工具获取与考核、敏感数据许可分别判断。
approved_tools.meaningEn: Public reports of AI guiding principles; ordinary degree students for discipline; research-related activity for investigation; distinct degree-review and SIGS unit rules.
approved_tools.meaningZh: 区分指导原则公开报道、普通学历学生纪律、研究活动调查、学位复核与深圳院级规则。

research_publication.en: For graduate theses and practical achievements, the public account prohibits replacing independent academic training and AI ghostwriting, plagiarism or fabrication; supervisors provide guidance and oversight. Research-misconduct investigation and degree non-conferral/revocation have distinct authorities, response rights and review routes. SIGS rules are unit-specific.
research_publication.zh: 研究生论文与实践成果不得用 AI 替代本人应完成的学术训练，严禁代写、剽窃、伪造；导师负责指导监督。研究调查、学位不授予／撤销分别适用各自认定机关、陈述申辩与复核路径；深圳院规则仅限该院。
research_publication.meaningEn: Public reports of AI guiding principles; ordinary degree students for discipline; research-related activity for investigation; distinct degree-review and SIGS unit rules.
research_publication.meaningZh: 区分指导原则公开报道、普通学历学生纪律、研究活动调查、学位复核与深圳院级规则。

academic_integrity.en: Separate research investigation (15 working days for acceptance, five working days to form the group; normally three-month investigation/six-month overall handling, with suspension/extension rules), student discipline (five-working-day defense and ten-day expulsion-hearing request), student appeals (ten-day filing, normally fifteen-day review with possible fifteen-day extension), and degree review (thirty days after acceptance). These clocks and scopes are not interchangeable.
academic_integrity.zh: 研究调查、学生纪律、校内申诉与学位复核各有范围和起算点：研究线索受理 15 个工作日，正式立项后 5 个工作日组建调查组；处分陈述申辩 5 个工作日、开除听证申请 10 日；申诉申请 10 日、复查通常 15 日且复杂时可延 15 日；学位复核自受理起 30 日。须阅读各自例外，不合并为通用期限。
academic_integrity.meaningEn: Public reports of AI guiding principles; ordinary degree students for discipline; research-related activity for investigation; distinct degree-review and SIGS unit rules.
academic_integrity.meaningZh: 区分指导原则公开报道、普通学历学生纪律、研究活动调查、学位复核与深圳院级规则。

teaching_guidance.en: The public news account recommends that instructors determine AI methods and extent from teaching objectives, explain usage rules at the start of a course and remain responsible for AI-generated teaching materials. The full guiding-principles document and specific AI-grading/upload-consent rules were not obtained.
teaching_guidance.zh: 公开报道建议教师依教学目标确定 AI 应用方式和程度、开课时说明规范，并对 AI 生成教学内容负责。指导原则全文与具体 AI 评分／上传学生作业的同意规则尚未取得。
teaching_guidance.meaningEn: Public reports of AI guiding principles; ordinary degree students for discipline; research-related activity for investigation; distinct degree-review and SIGS unit rules.
teaching_guidance.meaningZh: 区分指导原则公开报道、普通学历学生纪律、研究活动调查、学位复核与深圳院级规则。

security_procurement.en: The guiding-principles account supplies a sensitive-data restriction; it does not establish a complete public procurement or security-approval workflow. No verified universal approval route was found in this bounded review.
security_procurement.zh: 已有敏感数据限制，但本次已审材料不足以建立完整公开采购或安全审批流程，保留证据缺口。

topicBasis.exams: The reviewed public sources do not establish AI permission for a particular exam. General rules address unauthorized electronic-device retrieval and cheating; Xiaoda access grants no exam permission. Obtain the applicable exam instructions before using AI.

These clocks and scopes are not interchangeable.

do.en: Check the course and exam instructions before using AI.
do.zh: 使用 AI 前核对课程和该场考试要求。

do.en: Declare substantive AI contributions as required for the task.
do.zh: 依任务要求清晰声明 AI 的实质性贡献。

do.en: Use the response or review route that matches your decision; check its exact clock.
do.zh: 按决定类型选择陈述申辩、复核或申诉路径，核对具体起算点。

dont.en: Do not submit copied or simply paraphrased AI output as your academic work.
dont.zh: 不得把直接复制或简单转述的 AI 内容作为学业成果提交。

dont.en: Do not use AI for thesis ghostwriting, plagiarism or fabrication.
dont.zh: 不得利用 AI 实施论文代写、剽窃或伪造。

dont.en: Do not use sensitive, classified or unauthorized data to train or drive models.
dont.zh: 不得以敏感、涉密或未授权数据训练或驱动模型。

cl-tsinghua-university-institutional-ai-.text: Tsinghua’s historical English feature reports Xiaoda was introduced to incoming freshmen in 2024. A September 2026 university-hosted report states it opened to all undergraduate and graduate students in June 2025. This is an institutional access statement, not permission for assessments; authenticated access and current feature entitlements were not tested.
cl-tsinghua-university-institutional-ai-.scope: Historical tool introduction; access conditions require current evidence

evidence.quote: In 2024, Tsinghua launched a suite of transformative artificial intelligence (AI) educational tools, including ‘Xiaoda’ — a student AI growth assistant. The chatbot-style interface was introduced to all incoming freshmen to enhance their learning experiences, offer life guidance, deepen their self-awareness, and promote their holistic development.
evidence.location: Providing growth support; historical 2024 freshman introduction; extracted text lines 97-97

evidence.quote: “清小搭”是清华大学自主研发、基于人工智能技术构建的全功能智能体学伴，2024年8月面向本科新生上线试用，2025年6月面向全体本研学生全面开放。
evidence.location: 2026-09-29 report, 筑牢枢纽平台; extracted text lines 40-40

claim-tsinghua-university-1.text: The university’s public news account of its AI Education Guiding Principles reports: Tsinghua University prohibits students from directly copying or mechanically paraphrasing AI-generated text, code, or other output and submitting it as academic coursework.
claim-tsinghua-university-1.scope: Public news disclosure of guiding principles; graduate thesis scope for Claims 2 and 8; course rules for Claims 1 and 7

evidence.quote: 鼓励同学们在遵守课程规定的前提下积极探索人工智能工具辅助学习，但严禁将人工智能生成的文本、代码等内容直接复制或简单转述后作为学业成果提交。
evidence.location: 教学篇 section, student guidance paragraph; extracted text lines 41-41

claim-tsinghua-university-2.text: The university’s public news account of its AI Education Guiding Principles reports: Tsinghua University prohibits using AI to replace academic training that graduate students are expected to complete independently, and strictly forbids AI-assisted ghostwriting, plagiarism, and fabrication in theses, dissertations, and practical achievements.
claim-tsinghua-university-2.scope: Public news disclosure of guiding principles; graduate thesis scope for Claims 2 and 8; course rules for Claims 1 and 7

evidence.quote: 禁止用人工智能代替本应由本人进行的学术训练，严禁使用人工智能实施代写、剽窃、伪造等行为。
evidence.location: 学位论文及实践成果篇 section, graduate student restrictions paragraph; extracted text lines 42-42

claim-tsinghua-university-4.text: The university’s public news account of its AI Education Guiding Principles reports: Tsinghua University prohibits teachers and students from using sensitive information, classified data, or unauthorized data to train or operate AI models.
claim-tsinghua-university-4.scope: Public news disclosure of guiding principles; graduate thesis scope for Claims 2 and 8; course rules for Claims 1 and 7

evidence.quote: “数据安全”原则划出清晰红线，严禁师生使用敏感信息、涉密数据或未授权数据训练或驱动人工智能模型。
evidence.location: 总则 section, five core principles - 数据安全; extracted text lines 38-38

claim-tsinghua-university-5.text: The university’s public news account of its AI Education Guiding Principles reports: Tsinghua University's Guiding Principles establish five core principles for AI in education: principal responsibility (AI as auxiliary tool, teachers and students as primary agents), compliance and integrity, data security, prudence and critical thinking, and fairness and inclusiveness.
claim-tsinghua-university-5.scope: Public news disclosure of guiding principles; graduate thesis scope for Claims 2 and 8; course rules for Claims 1 and 7

evidence.quote: “总则”部分明确了学校“积极而审慎”的基本立场，并提出“主体责任”“合规诚信”“数据安全”“审慎思辨”“公平包容”五大核心原则。
evidence.location: 总则 section, opening paragraph on core principles; extracted text lines 37-37

claim-tsinghua-university-6.text: The university’s public news account of its AI Education Guiding Principles reports: Tsinghua University affirms that AI must remain an auxiliary tool and that teachers and students are the primary agents in teaching and learning (principal responsibility principle).
claim-tsinghua-university-6.scope: Public news disclosure of guiding principles; graduate thesis scope for Claims 2 and 8; course rules for Claims 1 and 7

evidence.quote: “主体责任”原则强调人工智能始终是辅助工具，师生才是教学与学习的主导者。
evidence.location: 总则 section, five core principles - 主体责任; extracted text lines 38-38

claim-tsinghua-university-3.text: The university’s public news account of its AI Education Guiding Principles reports: Tsinghua University requires teachers and students to disclose their use of AI and AI-generated content in accordance with regulations, as part of the 'compliance and integrity' principle.
claim-tsinghua-university-3.scope: Public news disclosure of guiding principles; graduate thesis scope for Claims 2 and 8; course rules for Claims 1 and 7

evidence.quote: “合规诚信”原则要求师生对人工智能使用情况及生成内容依规进行披露声明，严禁学术不端。
evidence.location: 总则 section, five core principles - 合规诚信; extracted text lines 38-38

claim-tsinghua-university-7.text: The university’s public news account of its AI Education Guiding Principles reports: Tsinghua University advises instructors to determine how AI should be used according to course objectives, clearly explain AI usage norms to students at the start of each course, and remain responsible for AI-generated teaching materials.
claim-tsinghua-university-7.scope: Public news disclosure of guiding principles; graduate thesis scope for Claims 2 and 8; course rules for Claims 1 and 7

evidence.quote: 建议教师们基于教学目标自主制定人工智能的应用方式与程度，在课程开始时向学生明确说明使用规范，并对人工智能生成的教学内容负责。
evidence.location: 教学篇 section, instructor guidance paragraph; extracted text lines 40-40

claim-tsinghua-university-8.text: The university’s public news account of its AI Education Guiding Principles reports: Tsinghua University requires graduate supervisors to provide normative guidance on AI use and maintain full-process oversight to ensure the integrity of academic training and the originality of theses, dissertations, and practical achievements.
claim-tsinghua-university-8.scope: Public news disclosure of guiding principles; graduate thesis scope for Claims 2 and 8; course rules for Claims 1 and 7

evidence.quote: 研究生指导教师需在此过程中提供规范性指导并进行全过程监督，确保学术训练的完整性和学位论文及实践成果的原创性。
evidence.location: 学位论文及实践成果篇 section, supervisor responsibilities paragraph; extracted text lines 42-42

claim-tsinghua-university-9.text: The university’s public news account of its AI Education Guiding Principles reports: Tsinghua University urges vigilance toward AI 'hallucinations' and stresses multi-source verification to guard against cognitive complacency from overreliance on AI (prudence and critical thinking principle).
claim-tsinghua-university-9.scope: Public news disclosure of guiding principles; graduate thesis scope for Claims 2 and 8; course rules for Claims 1 and 7

evidence.quote: “审慎思辨”原则提醒师生警惕人工智能“幻觉”，应通过多源验证防范因过度依赖导致的思维惰化。
evidence.location: 总则 section, five core principles - 审慎思辨; extracted text lines 38-38

claim-tsinghua-university-10.text: The university’s public news account of its AI Education Guiding Principles reports: Tsinghua University's Guiding Principles call for identifying and mitigating algorithmic bias and the digital divide to ensure technology serves the public good (fairness and inclusiveness principle).
claim-tsinghua-university-10.scope: Public news disclosure of guiding principles; graduate thesis scope for Claims 2 and 8; course rules for Claims 1 and 7

evidence.quote: “公平包容”原则呼吁主动识别并努力降低算法偏见与数字鸿沟，推动技术向善。
evidence.location: 总则 section, five core principles - 公平包容; extracted text lines 38-38

claim-tsinghua-university-11.text: The university’s public news account of its AI Education Guiding Principles reports: Tsinghua University explicitly encourages and supports faculty and students to pursue innovative applications of AI in teaching and learning, and commits to recognizing and promoting exemplary practices.
claim-tsinghua-university-11.scope: Public news disclosure of guiding principles; graduate thesis scope for Claims 2 and 8; course rules for Claims 1 and 7

evidence.quote: 学校积极鼓励并支持全体师生勇于探索人工智能在教育教学中的创新性应用，并将对优秀实践给予肯定与推广。
evidence.location: 未来已来 section, innovation encouragement paragraph; extracted text lines 66-66

cl-tsinghua-disclosure-trigger.text: The university-hosted interview reports that when AI makes a substantive contribution to an academic outcome, students must clearly and prominently mark or declare its use as required by the university, unit or instructor. The interview is public explanatory evidence, not the retrieved full guiding-principles document.
cl-tsinghua-disclosure-trigger.scope: University-wide, within the stated academic context

evidence.quote: 若在学术任务中应用人工智能并在相关成果中包含了人工智能的实质性贡献，学生必须按照学校、院系或任课教师的要求，对人工智能的使用情况进行清晰、显著的标注或声明。
evidence.location: Interview, 共识如何凝聚; extracted text lines 57-57

cl-tsinghua-guidance-hierarchy.text: An official-site interview explains that the AI Guiding Principles interface with the existing teaching and academic standards system rather than replace specific management rules. Units and instructors must provide the applicable implementation details.
cl-tsinghua-guidance-hierarchy.scope: University-wide, within the stated academic context

evidence.quote: 二是必须实现与学校现有教学管理体系制度的无缝衔接，即将《指导原则》作为一个‘接口’或‘指南’，而非替代具体管理办法，以融入清华大学已有且成熟的教育教学和学术规范管理体系。
evidence.location: Interpretation, 什么变？什么不变？; extracted text lines 66-66

cl-tsinghua-xiaoda-current-access.text: A university-hosted report dated 29 September 2026 states Xiaoda opened to all undergraduate and graduate students in June 2025 after its 2024 freshman pilot. Account access, feature entitlements and pricing were not independently tested. This does not authorize coursework or exam use.
cl-tsinghua-xiaoda-current-access.scope: University-wide, within the stated academic context

evidence.quote: “清小搭”是清华大学自主研发、基于人工智能技术构建的全功能智能体学伴，2024年8月面向本科新生上线试用，2025年6月面向全体本研学生全面开放。
evidence.location: 2026-09-29 report, 筑牢枢纽平台; extracted text lines 40-40

cl-tsinghua-xiaoda-pilot-version.text: An undated Student Learning and Development Center page still describes Xiaoda as a pilot limited to 2024 undergraduates. This is retained as historical/conflicting page wording; the dated September 2026 report supplies the later broader opening statement. Current authenticated eligibility is untested.
cl-tsinghua-xiaoda-pilot-version.scope: University-wide, within the stated academic context

evidence.quote: 扫描下面二维码进行网页版登录或微信小程序登录；或微信搜索“清华大学学生成长助手清小搭”小程序进行使用。（目前处于试运行阶段，仅面向2024级本科生开放）
evidence.location: 二、使用方式; undated pilot wording; extracted text lines 31-31

cl-tsinghua-research-investigation-scope.text: The 2025 Academic Misconduct Investigation Measures apply to faculty, staff and students in academic research and related activities. They are not a universal procedure for every course-grade disagreement.
cl-tsinghua-research-investigation-scope.scope: University-wide, within the stated academic context

evidence.quote: 第二条 本办法适用于对学校师生员工在学术研究及相关活动中发生的违反学术研究行为准则、违背学术诚信的各类行为的调查认定相关工作。
evidence.location: Article 2; extracted text lines 239-239

cl-tsinghua-research-investigation-repea.text: The investigation measures take effect on publication (17 November 2025) and repeal the earlier Prevention and Handling of Academic Misconduct Measures adopted in the 2016–2017 academic year. Preserve the older version as history.
cl-tsinghua-research-investigation-repea.scope: University-wide, within the stated academic context

evidence.quote:
第二十三条 本办法自公布之日起施行。2016～2017学年度第10次校务会议讨论通过的《清华大学预防与处理学术不端行为办法》同时废止。
下一条：清华大学学术委员会章程
evidence.location: Article 23; extracted text lines 281-282

cl-tsinghua-research-investigation-entry.text: For research-misconduct reports, the discipline planning office organizes preliminary verification and determines acceptance/registration within 15 working days, notifying the reporting unit or named reporter and explaining rejection in writing. Article 9 also lists grounds for non-acceptance.
cl-tsinghua-research-investigation-entry.scope: University-wide, within the stated academic context

evidence.quote: 第九条  对于通过举报获得的师生员工涉嫌存在学术不端行为的线索，学科办应当及时组织初步核实，在十五个工作日内明确是否受理立项并通知提供线索的单位或实名举报人等（以下统称实名举报人），不予受理立项的应当书面说明理由。对于具有以下情形之一的举报，可以不予受理立项：
evidence.location: Article 9, opening paragraph; extracted text lines 254-254

cl-tsinghua-research-investigation-panel.text: Within five working days after formal registration, the university academic committee forms an investigation group of at least five and the discipline planning office gives the investigated person written notice. This deadline is for constituting a research investigation, not a student appeal.
cl-tsinghua-research-investigation-panel.scope: University-wide, within the stated academic context

evidence.quote: 第十条 正式立项后五个工作日内，学校学术委员会组建调查组开展调查，制定调查方案，明确调查内容、人员、方式、进度安排、保障措施、工作纪律等。调查组成员应当不少于五人，由学校学术委员会相关专项委员会或相关院系学术委员会委员担任。学科办应当书面告知被调查人已启动调查程序。
evidence.location: Article 10, opening paragraph; extracted text lines 262-262

cl-tsinghua-research-response.text: Research fact-finding must protect the investigated person’s right to make a statement and verify the relevant facts, reasons and evidence.
cl-tsinghua-research-response.scope: University-wide, within the stated academic context

evidence.quote: 事实调查过程中应当保障被调查人陈述的权利，对有关事实、理由和证据进行核实。
evidence.location: Article 11; extracted text lines 266-266

cl-tsinghua-research-recusal.text: Participants in academic-misconduct investigations and determinations must recuse themselves where their or relatives’ interests could affect fairness.
cl-tsinghua-research-recusal.scope: University-wide, within the stated academic context

evidence.quote: 第二十条 学术不端行为调查认定过程中应当严格执行回避制度。调查组和学术评议专家组成员、学校学术委员会委员（以下统称参与人员）本人及其亲属等与实名举报人或被举报人等存在可能影响公平公正调查认定的利害关系的，相关参与人员应当回避。
evidence.location: Article 20; extracted text lines 278-278

cl-tsinghua-research-decision.text: The university academic committee determines whether conduct is academic misconduct and its gravity from the investigation report. evidence.quote: 第二十五条 学生违反课程考核纪律的，该课程考核成绩无效（记0分或者F等级）。
evidence.location: Article 25; undergraduate regulations; extracted text lines 291-291

cl-tsinghua-undergrad-certificates.text: The undergraduate student-status regulations provide for lawful revocation of academic/degree certificates obtained through cheating, plagiarism or other academic misconduct or improper means, and the specified registration cancellation. Degree decisions also have the distinct 2026 degree-measures procedure.
cl-tsinghua-undergrad-certificates.scope: Undergraduates; certificates obtained by the specified improper means

evidence.quote:
第四十九条 对违反国家招生规定取得入学资格或者学籍的，学校予以取消学籍，不发给学历证书、学位证书；已发的学历证书、学位证书，学校依法予以撤销。
对以作弊、剽窃、抄袭等学术不端行为或者其他不正当手段获得学历证书、学位证书的，学校依法予以撤销。
被撤销的学历证书、学位证书已注册的，学校予以注销并报教育行政部门宣布无效。
evidence.location: Article 49; undergraduate regulations; extracted text lines 349-351

scope.en: Campus appropriate-use advisory; Academic Senate instructor recommendations; Student Conduct Code July 1, 2026; Graduate GAMP; 2026 Research Misconduct Policy.
scope.zh: 区分校级合规使用指引、学术参议院大纲建议、2026 年 7 月 1 日学生行为准则、研究生 GAMP 及 2026 年研究不端制度。

coursework.en: Coursework use is conditioned on explicit instructor permission in the syllabus; unauthorized use of AI on academic assignments is prohibited by campus guidance and constitutes academic misconduct under Section 102.01.
coursework.zh: 作业中的 AI 使用须依课程大纲中任课教师的明确规定；未经许可在学业作业中使用 AI 违反校方指导并构成第 102.01 条学术不端。
coursework.meaningEn: Campus appropriate-use advisory; Academic Senate instructor recommendations; Student Conduct Code July 1, 2026; Graduate GAMP; 2026 Research Misconduct Policy.
coursework.meaningZh: 区分校级合规使用指引、学术参议院大纲建议、2026 年 7 月 1 日学生行为准则、研究生 GAMP 及 2026 年研究不端制度。

exams.en: No universal campus-wide AI exam permission or prohibition is established by reviewed policy; whether AI is permitted on specific examinations is governed by instructor authorization in individual course syllabi or exam instructions rather than central campus policy. Tool access does not constitute exam permission.
exams.zh: 已审核公开政策未建立全校统一的考试 AI 许可或禁令；具体考试是否允许使用 AI 取决于任课教师在课程大纲或考试指引中的明确规定，而非校级统一规定。校内工具授权不构成考试许可。
exams.meaningEn: Campus appropriate-use advisory; Academic Senate instructor recommendations; Student Conduct Code July 1, 2026; Graduate GAMP; 2026 Research Misconduct Policy.
exams.meaningZh: 区分校级合规使用指引、学术参议院大纲建议、2026 年 7 月 1 日学生行为准则、研究生 GAMP 及 2026 年研究不端制度。

disclosure.en: Academic Senate guidance provides optional syllabus frameworks for instructors to require tool acknowledgment and prompt descriptions on permitted assignments. Researchers should disclose generative AI use in research reports, manuscripts, and publications where appropriate (specifying tools, scope, and human verification); for grant proposals, researchers should follow applicable funding agency disclosure requirements.
disclosure.zh: 学术参议院为教师提供可选的大纲范本，在获准的作业中要求说明工具并说明提示词。研究人员在研究报告、手稿与出版物中应在适当时依联邦与校方指导披露生成式 AI 使用（说明工具、范围与人工验证）；基金申报则应遵循各资助机构的具体披露要求。
disclosure.meaningEn: Campus appropriate-use advisory; Academic Senate instructor recommendations; Student Conduct Code July 1, 2026; Graduate GAMP; 2026 Research Misconduct Policy.
disclosure.meaningZh: 区分校级合规使用指引、学术参议院大纲建议、2026 年 7 月 1 日学生行为准则、研究生 GAMP 及 2026 年研究不端制度。

privacy_data.en: Public Protection Level P1 data may be entered into AI tools. Entering confidential, personal, or proprietary information (including FERPA student records, unpublished research, or P2–P4 data) is generally prohibited, unless specifically permitted under UC enterprise license agreements and approved protection levels. Instructors are advised not to upload student materials to third-party AI tools lacking a university MOU.
privacy_data.zh: 公开的保护等级 P1 信息可输入 AI 工具。严禁输入个人、机密或专有信息（含 FERPA 学生记录、未发表研究及 P2–P4 数据），除非获得 UC 企业许可协议的具体授权并符合批准的数据等级限制。因学生隐私保护，建议教师不要向未与校方签订 MOU 的第三方 AI 工具上传学生材料。
privacy_data.meaningEn: Campus appropriate-use advisory; Academic Senate instructor recommendations; Student Conduct Code July 1, 2026; Graduate GAMP; 2026 Research Misconduct Policy.
privacy_data.meaningZh: 区分校级合规使用指引、学术参议院大纲建议、2026 年 7 月 1 日学生行为准则、研究生 GAMP 及 2026 年研究不端制度。

approved_tools.en: Berkeley licenses tools including ChatGPT Edu, Gemini, Copilot, BearGPT, and Campus AI Sandbox via CalNet authentication, with varying user eligibility, recharge fees, and P1–P3 data levels. Institutional licensing does not establish course or examination permission.
approved_tools.zh: 伯克利通过 CalNet 认证提供 ChatGPT Edu、Gemini、Copilot、BearGPT 及 Campus AI Sandbox 等工具，各自具备不同人员资格、内部结算要求与 P1–P3 保护级别。校园工具授权不代表课程或考试获准。
approved_tools.meaningEn: Campus appropriate-use advisory; Academic Senate instructor recommendations; Student Conduct Code July 1, 2026; Graduate GAMP; 2026 Research Misconduct Policy.
approved_tools.meaningZh: 区分校级合规使用指引、学术参议院大纲建议、2026 年 7 月 1 日学生行为准则、研究生 GAMP 及 2026 年研究不端制度。

research_publication.en: Effective January 1, 2026, research misconduct allegations follow standardized assessment, inquiry, and investigation stages evaluated against a three-part standard, with a 7-year record retention requirement. Researchers are responsible for AI-assisted research and should ensure human verification of facts and citations; Library database scraping/training requires license compliance.
research_publication.zh: 2026 年 1 月 1 日生效的研究不端制度设立评估、初查与正式调查三阶段，依据三要素标准认定，并要求案卷记录妥善保存 7 年。研究人员对 AI 辅助研究负全责并应人工核实事实与文献引用；图书馆授权资源的使用必须遵守数据库许可。
research_publication.meaningEn: Campus appropriate-use advisory; Academic Senate instructor recommendations; Student Conduct Code July 1, 2026; Graduate GAMP; 2026 Research Misconduct Policy.
research_publication.meaningZh: 区分校级合规使用指引、学术参议院大纲建议、2026 年 7 月 1 日学生行为准则、研究生 GAMP 及 2026 年研究不端制度。

academic_integrity.en: Undergraduate and general student conduct is governed by the Berkeley Campus Code of Student Conduct revised July 1, 2026 (PACAOS 100.00 / Appendix H) with a 10-day appeal window. Graduate academic misconduct is adjudicated separately under Graduate Division GAMP with early resolution, formal committee hearings under a preponderance standard, and a 10-day appeal right.
academic_integrity.zh: 本科生及一般学生行为受 2026 年 7 月 1 日修订的《伯克利分校学生行为准则》（PACAOS 100.00 / 附录 H）管辖并设 10 天申诉期。研究生学术不端由研究生院 GAMP 独立管辖，设早期调解、按优势证据标准的委员会听证及 10 天申诉权。
academic_integrity.meaningEn: Campus appropriate-use advisory; Academic Senate instructor recommendations; Student Conduct Code July 1, 2026; Graduate GAMP; 2026 Research Misconduct Policy.
academic_integrity.meaningZh: 区分校级合规使用指引、学术参议院大纲建议、2026 年 7 月 1 日学生行为准则、研究生 GAMP 及 2026 年研究不端制度。

teaching_guidance.en: The Academic Senate recommends clear syllabus expectations, notes that AI detectors are unvalidated, and reminds instructors to ensure student computing access for required tools. Turnitin AI writing detection is not enabled for general bCourses use.
teaching_guidance.zh: 学术参议院建议大纲载明明确预期，指出 AI 检测工具未经验证，并提醒教师为必用工具提供计算资源保障。bCourses 未在全校启用 Turnitin AI 写作检测。
teaching_guidance.meaningEn: Campus appropriate-use advisory; Academic Senate instructor recommendations; Student Conduct Code July 1, 2026; Graduate GAMP; 2026 Research Misconduct Policy.
teaching_guidance.meaningZh: 区分校级合规使用指引、学术参议院大纲建议、2026 年 7 月 1 日学生行为准则、研究生 GAMP 及 2026 年研究不端制度。

security_procurement.en: UC Berkeley requires unit-procured tools to adhere to approved protection levels and warns against personal liability from unapproved click-through terms. AI pre-screening questions evaluate organizational risk before committee review.
security_procurement.zh: 伯克利要求院系独立采购的工具遵守批准的保护等级，警告非授权点击接受协议需承担个人法律责任。AI 预筛查问卷用于在委员会审查前评估机构风险。
security_procurement.meaningEn: Campus appropriate-use advisory; Academic Senate instructor recommendations; Student Conduct Code July 1, 2026; Graduate GAMP; 2026 Research Misconduct Policy.
security_procurement.meaningZh: 区分校级合规使用指引、学术参议院大纲建议、2026 年 7 月 1 日学生行为准则、研究生 GAMP 及 2026 年研究不端制度。

do.en: Review the specific course syllabus and exam guidelines before using generative AI in coursework.
do.zh: 在课程作业中使用生成式 AI 前，先查阅具体课程大纲与考试规定。

do.en: Authenticate with CalNet to access Berkeley-licensed AI tools with institutional data protections for approved Protection Levels P2/P3.
do.zh: 通过 CalNet 统一身份认证使用获学校授权的 AI 工具，以在批准的 P2/P3 等级内享有机构协议保护。

do.en: Review and follow applicable funding agency disclosure rules when submitting research grant proposals, and disclose GenAI in publications where appropriate.
do.zh: 在提交资助申请时遵循各资助机构的具体披露要求，并在适当时于研究出版物中说明 AI 工具使用与人工验证。

dont.en: Do not enter FERPA student records, non-public course materials, or confidential P2–P4 research data into unapproved consumer AI tools lacking UC contractual protections.
dont.zh: 切勿向缺少 UC 协议保护的非授权消费级 AI 工具输入受 FERPA 保护的学生记录、非公开教学材料或保密研究数据。

dont.en: Do not assume campus tool licensing conveys permission to use AI for course assignments or examinations.
dont.zh: 切勿将学校授权提供某款 AI 工具等同于获准将其用于课程作业或考试考核。

dont.en: Do not accept vendor click-through contracts without delegated signature authority; instructors are advised not to upload student work to third parties without an institutional MOU.
dont.zh: 无授权人员切勿擅自点击同意供应商协议；建议任课教师不要向未与学校签订 MOU 的第三方上传学生学业材料。

claim-university-of-california-berkeley-.text: UC Berkeley warns that individuals who accept click-through agreements for AI tools (such as OpenAI and ChatGPT terms of use) without delegated signature authority may face personal liability, including responsibility for compliance with terms and conditions.
claim-university-of-california-berkeley-.scope: Office of Ethics, Risk and Compliance Services guidance

evidence.quote: Personal Liability: Please note that certain generative AI tools use click-through agreements. Click-through agreements, including OpenAI and ChatGPT terms of use, are contracts. Individuals who accept click-through agreements without delegated signature authority may face personal consequences, including responsibility for compliance with terms and conditions.
evidence.location: OERCS Appropriate Use: Click-through contracts; extracted text lines 71-71

claim-university-of-california-berkeley-.text: UC Berkeley requires researchers to comply with varying license agreement terms before using or training AI tools with materials acquired from library-licensed resources or databases. Violations can result in personal liability and campus-wide loss of access to critical research resources.
claim-university-of-california-berkeley-.scope: Office of Ethics, Risk and Compliance Services guidance

evidence.quote: Using AI with Library Digital Resources: Before using or training AI tools with materials acquired from Library-licensed resources or databases, researchers must comply with varying license agreement terms. Violations can result in personal liability and campus-wide loss of access to critical research resources.
evidence.location: OERCS Appropriate Use: Library resources; extracted text lines 72-72

evidence.quote: In all cases, use should be consistent with UC Berkeley’s Principles of Community and the UC Principles of Responsible AI (summary / full report)

In the absence of such a statement, students may be more likely to use these technologies inappropriately.

claim-university-of-california-berkeley-.text: Under the Berkeley Campus Code of Student Conduct, written appeals must be submitted within 10 days of the Administrative Resolution Letter (or within 5 days for intent to appeal and 10 days for appeal if separation status is involved); sanctions are deferred during a timely appeal.

scope.en: Subject-level assessment guidelines; Student Academic Integrity Policy (MPF1310); Student Appeals Policy (MPF1323); Responsible Conduct of Research Policy (MPF1318 cl 5.11); Open-book exams advice; Canvas LMS privacy notice.
scope.zh: 区分课程大纲具体规定、学生学术诚信制度（MPF1310）、学生申诉规定（MPF1323）、负责任科研行为准则（MPF1318 第 5.11 条）、开卷考试指南及 Canvas LMS 隐私通告。

coursework.en: At the University of Melbourne, each Subject Coordinator sets the boundaries of appropriate GenAI use in their subject; students must check before using AI for assessment-related work and produce the submitted work themselves unless explicitly authorized.
coursework.zh: 在墨尔本大学，由各课程主管教师确定本课程及考核作业中生成式 AI 的使用边界；学生在将 AI 用于考核作业前须查验明确许可，且除获准情形外须独立完成提交作品。
coursework.meaningEn: Subject-level assessment guidelines; Student Academic Integrity Policy (MPF1310); Student Appeals Policy (MPF1323); Responsible Conduct of Research Policy (MPF1318 cl 5.11); Open-book exams advice; Canvas LMS privacy notice.
coursework.meaningZh: 区分课程大纲具体规定、学生学术诚信制度（MPF1310）、学生申诉规定（MPF1323）、负责任科研行为准则（MPF1318 第 5.11 条）、开卷考试指南及 Canvas LMS 隐私通告。

exams.en: In University of Melbourne examinations, students must verify whether GenAI is authorised by the Subject Coordinator or exam instructions, and if permitted, use only approved tools and specified permitted uses. Tool access conveys no exam authorization, and unauthorised or undisclosed AI use in exams constitutes academic misconduct under MPF1310.
exams.zh: 在墨尔本大学的考试中，学生必须查验本场考试是否经课程主管教师或考试大纲明确授权使用 GenAI；如获许可，仅能使用核准工具及限定用途。拥有校内工具权限不代表获准在考试中使用，未经授权或未披露在考试中使用 AI 构成 MPF1310 学术不端。
exams.meaningEn: Subject-level assessment guidelines; Student Academic Integrity Policy (MPF1310); Student Appeals Policy (MPF1323); Responsible Conduct of Research Policy (MPF1318 cl 5.11); Open-book exams advice; Canvas LMS privacy notice.
exams.meaningZh: 区分课程大纲具体规定、学生学术诚信制度（MPF1310）、学生申诉规定（MPF1323）、负责任科研行为准则（MPF1318 第 5.11 条）、开卷考试指南及 Canvas LMS 隐私通告。

disclosure.en: University of Melbourne guidance mandates a dual disclosure framework: citing AI outputs in the reference list when quoting or paraphrasing does not replace an acknowledgement declaration; students must provide both a citation and a process declaration describing how tools were used, with unauthorised or undisclosed use constituting misconduct under MPF1310.
disclosure.zh: 墨尔本大学实行双重披露机制：在参考文献中引用或转述 AI 输出不能替代使用声明；学生既须规范引用，又须附具过程性声明详细说明工具使用环节。未经授权或未加披露使用 AI 构成 MPF1310 学术不端。
disclosure.meaningEn: Subject-level assessment guidelines; Student Academic Integrity Policy (MPF1310); Student Appeals Policy (MPF1323); Responsible Conduct of Research Policy (MPF1318 cl 5.11); Open-book exams advice; Canvas LMS privacy notice.
disclosure.meaningZh: 区分课程大纲具体规定、学生学术诚信制度（MPF1310）、学生申诉规定（MPF1323）、负责任科研行为准则（MPF1318 第 5.11 条）、开卷考试指南及 Canvas LMS 隐私通告。

privacy_data.en: Students and researchers must not upload personal data, private information, third-party copyright, or patentable IP to external AI platforms. University teaching and assessment IP must remain within SparkAI or sanctioned environments; student LMS interactions and AILA session metadata are retained and reviewable by authorized decision-makers under the LMS privacy collection notice.
privacy_data.zh: 学生与研究人员严禁向外部 AI 平台上传个人隐私、第三方版权或可申请专利的成果。课程考核与教学材料仅能在 SparkAI 或校内核准平台处理；学生在 LMS 内的交互记录及 AILA 会话元数据依法保留，授权决策人员可在调查时进行核查。
privacy_data.meaningEn: Subject-level assessment guidelines; Student Academic Integrity Policy (MPF1310); Student Appeals Policy (MPF1323); Responsible Conduct of Research Policy (MPF1318 cl 5.11); Open-book exams advice; Canvas LMS privacy notice.
privacy_data.meaningZh: 区分课程大纲具体规定、学生学术诚信制度（MPF1310）、学生申诉规定（MPF1323）、负责任科研行为准则（MPF1318 第 5.11 条）、开卷考试指南及 Canvas LMS 隐私通告。

approved_tools.en: The University of Melbourne provides AILA within Canvas LMS where enabled by coordinators, SparkAI as a secure internal platform for staff (student access prohibited), Turnitin AI writing detection as an investigative diagnostic in similarity reports, and M365 Copilot Chat for student study support. Institutional access conveys neither coursework nor examination permission.
approved_tools.zh: 墨尔本大学在教师启用的 Canvas 课程中提供 AILA 学习助手，为教职员工提供安全的 SparkAI 内部平台（禁止学生访问），在查重报告中提供 Turnitin AI 检测作为核查线索，并为学生提供 M365 Copilot Chat。校方提供工具不代表获得作业或考试使用许可。
approved_tools.meaningEn: Subject-level assessment guidelines; Student Academic Integrity Policy (MPF1310); Student Appeals Policy (MPF1323); Responsible Conduct of Research Policy (MPF1318 cl 5.11); Open-book exams advice; Canvas LMS privacy notice.
approved_tools.meaningZh: 区分课程大纲具体规定、学生学术诚信制度（MPF1310）、学生申诉规定（MPF1323）、负责任科研行为准则（MPF1318 第 5.11 条）、开卷考试指南及 Canvas LMS 隐私通告。

research_publication.en: Under section 5.11 of the Responsible Conduct of Research Policy (MPF1318) and active University guidance, researchers must document DAT use, disclose tools in outputs, and obtain privacy/security/ethics approvals. For graduate research theses, AI editing is strictly restricted to minor language and clarity support under Australian Standards for Editing Practice, with supervisor AI review requiring explicit written candidate consent.
research_publication.zh: 依据现行《负责任科研行为准则》（MPF1318）第 5.11 条及校方指导，科研人员必须如实记录数字辅助工具使用、在科研成果中披露并取得隐私、安全与伦理审批。针对研究生毕业论文，AI 编辑严格限定为符合澳大利亚编辑标准的微调语言与润色，严禁实质性代写重写，导师使用 AI 审阅论文必须取得学生明确书面许可。
research_publication.meaningEn: Subject-level assessment guidelines; Student Academic Integrity Policy (MPF1310); Student Appeals Policy (MPF1323); Responsible Conduct of Research Policy (MPF1318 cl 5.11); Open-book exams advice; Canvas LMS privacy notice.
research_publication.meaningZh: 区分课程大纲具体规定、学生学术诚信制度（MPF1310）、学生申诉规定（MPF1323）、负责任科研行为准则（MPF1318 第 5.11 条）、开卷考试指南及 Canvas LMS 隐私通告。

academic_integrity.en: Under MPF1310, unauthorised or undisclosed technology use in assessable work constitutes academic misconduct. Poor Academic Practice is managed educatively by Subject Coordinators, distinct from formal Faculty Level 1 and Serious Level 2 misconduct. Turnitin AI detection reports serve as an investigative prompt rather than proof, students have the right to provide drafts and explanations in exploratory discussions, and MPF1323 establishes a 20-university-business-day appeal window.
academic_integrity.zh: 依据 MPF1310，在考核作业中未经许可或未加披露使用技术构成学术不端。良好学术素养欠缺（Poor Academic Practice）由教师开展教育性纠正，与正式的一级及二级学术不端严格区分。Turnitin AI 检测报告仅作为调查线索而非违纪证据，学生有权在探索性讨论中解释成果并提交草稿，MPF1323 设立 20 个大学工作日的申诉窗口。
academic_integrity.meaningEn: Subject-level assessment guidelines; Student Academic Integrity Policy (MPF1310); Student Appeals Policy (MPF1323); Responsible Conduct of Research Policy (MPF1318 cl 5.11); Open-book exams advice; Canvas LMS privacy notice.
academic_integrity.meaningZh: 区分课程大纲具体规定、学生学术诚信制度（MPF1310）、学生申诉规定（MPF1323）、负责任科研行为准则（MPF1318 第 5.11 条）、开卷考试指南及 Canvas LMS 隐私通告。

teaching_guidance.en: Melbourne teaching guidance advises Subject Coordinators to establish clear subject AI boundaries, model transparency, and provide guidance on translation and editing tool limits. GenAI tools must never substitute for staff evaluative judgement in marking or grading. Subjects are designed with at least 50% secure assessments to assure learning, supported by CSHE pedagogical assessment enhancement strategies.
teaching_guidance.zh: 墨尔本大学教学指引建议课程主管教师明确课程 AI 边界、以身作则披露使用，并就翻译与编辑工具的使用限度提供指导。生成式 AI 绝不能替代教师在评分考核中的学术评价判断。课程设计原则上要求至少 50% 安全考核以保障学习成效，并由 CSHE 提供考核优化教学策略。
teaching_guidance.meaningEn: Subject-level assessment guidelines; Student Academic Integrity Policy (MPF1310); Student Appeals Policy (MPF1323); Responsible Conduct of Research Policy (MPF1318 cl 5.11); Open-book exams advice; Canvas LMS privacy notice.
teaching_guidance.meaningZh: 区分课程大纲具体规定、学生学术诚信制度（MPF1310）、学生申诉规定（MPF1323）、负责任科研行为准则（MPF1318 第 5.11 条）、开卷考试指南及 Canvas LMS 隐私通告。

security_procurement.en: The University of Melbourne AI Principles establish an overarching governance framework emphasizing fairness, literacy, privacy, and security; staff testing of assessment materials must remain within SparkAI or sanctioned environments rather than public third-party services.
security_procurement.zh: 墨尔本大学 AI 原则在素养、公平、隐私与安全等维度建立顶层治理框架；教职员工审阅教学考核材料必须在 SparkAI 或校方核准平台进行，严禁使用公开消费级第三方服务。
security_procurement.meaningEn: Subject-level assessment guidelines; Student Academic Integrity Policy (MPF1310); Student Appeals Policy (MPF1323); Responsible Conduct of Research Policy (MPF1318 cl 5.11); Open-book exams advice; Canvas LMS privacy notice.
